comment: CalM also mentioned as SchM functions as a SAM-dependent N-methyltransferase in the biosynthesis of calcimycin (A23187)

reactions.description: CalM catalyzes methyl transfer to N-demethyl calcimycin to get the final product calcimycin

CalM/SchM is a type of N-methyltransferase responsible for the transfers of a methyl group to the precursor N-demethyl calcimycin to produce the antibiotic calcimycin (A23187) in Streptomyces chartreusis.
